# survivesLostConnections() function

Keep a pool's lost idle connection from ending the process.

**Signature:**

## Remarks

When the server closes a connection the pool is holding idle — a `pg_terminate_backend`<!-- -->, a failover, a maintenance restart — `pg` emits `error` on the pool itself. With no listener, that is an unhandled `error` event and Node exits. The pool has already discarded the client by then and the next checkout opens a fresh one, so the only thing left to do is say so.
